name: io.github.rafe-walker/kronicle-lite
description: Local-first hash-chained document store with signed retrieval receipts and an orient protocol that tells an agent when its beliefs went stale.

environmentVariables.name: KRONICLE_LITE_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the SQLite store and keys (default ~/.kronicle-lite)

environmentVariables.name: KRONICLE_LITE_ACTOR
environmentVariables.description: Actor id label used on cursors and writes (default local-agent)
